instruction: Insert a final slide in LibreOffice Impress showing a bulleted list of the titles from all earlier slides.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a summary slide with bullet points containing slide titles. The original presentation has 12 slides, so after adding a summary slide it should have 13 slides. The evaluator checks: (1) slide count increased to 13 (0.5 points), and (2) last slide has at least 5 bullet points with content (0.5 points). Verified by analyzing the PowerPoint structure - original has 12 slides with clear titles.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both structural and semantic requirements of the instruction
Getter extracts all necessary data: slide count, all slide titles from slides 1-N-1, and last slide content
Metric performs multi-level verification: (1) slide count check (0.3 pts), (2) minimum content check (0.2 pts), (3) semantic content matching using fuzzy substring comparison (0.5 pts)

The fuzzy matching logic (lines 28-53 in metric) uses case-insensitive substring matching to verify that last slide content contains actual slide titles, which is appropriate for handling formatting variations
Match thresholds are reasonable: 80% match for full credit, with partial credit for 50%-80% match, allowing flexibility while ensuring content correctness
Postconfig properly saves the file ensuring the getter can access the final state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adjusting min_titles from 5 to a higher value (e.g., 8-10) since the original presentation has 12 slides, to better ensure comprehensive coverage

Minor: The getter extracts titles by taking the first text shape from each slide (lines 50-57), which may occasionally miss the actual title if slide structure varies. Consider checking for title placeholders specifically using shape.has_text_frame and checking placeholder type
